prompts: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a wide 2:1 landscape raster background for a 2035 immersive interactive cinema website, one image only, not a collage or contact sheet. Cohesive photorealistic cinematic world, sophisticated holographic mixed reality. Match an existing dark midnight-navy environment (#071629, #081a2a), restrained cyan/seafoam (#72d9d0) and very faint lavender (#b29ad6), almost no warm white. Subdued low contrast. The actual interactive museum map will be overlaid by the website: reserve the middle 60 percent as dark, calm, visually unobstructed space, with subtle spatial depth rather than a bright portal. Keep all recognisable figures, hands and scroll details at the outer sides and lower corners. One continuous physical space and perspective, with modern glass/metal architecture on the left blending organically into historical Italian stone arcades and opera-theatre architecture on the right, not two disconnected pictures. Half contemporary and half ancient memories reconstructed by future technology. Peripheral holographic light is delicate, material and believable; faint atmospheric volumetric projection. No text, letters, numbers, logos, UI panels, rendered webpage, dominant central face, central bright object or white background. The image must complement a luminous cyan map, not compete with it. Scene 1 of a coherent three-shot sequence: entering VR cinema. At the far left edge a contemporary adult in a minimal dark jacket, seen in a restrained three-quarter side profile, wears a sleek unbranded VR visor and raises one hand toward a translucent floating rolled map-scroll visible low on the far right. The scroll combines the curled contour of antique vellum with fine cyan holographic light and a tiny violet touch glow; keep the scroll and hand outside the central map space. Ancient Italian theatre loggias and modern urban architecture share the same deep, dark environment. The gesture begins an encounter; no screen or cinema seats. Refined dreamlike realism, not a glossy science-fiction advertisement.
